data.body: **[P2] Clear MDC after an ordinary restore failure on the fatal path.** When End or preparation already selected an `InternalError` or `ThreadDeath`, this helper only suppresses a subsequent ordinary `restore.close()` failure. If that restore failed after an End hook wrote MDC, the fatal terminates a `ThreadPoolExecutor` worker and its replacement can inherit the dirty map (for example with `BasicMDCAdapter`), leaking execution metadata into later work. Apply the same guarded `MDC.clear()` fallback here while retaining the earlier fatal as primary, and add an End-fatal plus ordinary-restore-failure worker-reuse test.
